decision: Retain and optimize the current simulator. Reuse reviewed algorithmic ideas and independently implement the AlphaZero loop; do not begin a Rust simulator rewrite on the available evidence.

kaggle.cabtVersion: Public wrapper defaults to engine version 2; documentation identifies itself as 0.1.0.

rightsAndAccess.agentCode: The author's MIT license explicitly permits reuse with its copyright/permission notice. No foreign source text or weights were copied into the independent native AlphaZero implementation.
rightsAndAccess.publicWrapper: The official Kaggle repository contains Python wrappers and platform binaries under a repository-level Apache-2.0 license. No separate engine-source license was verified. The repository license must not be treated as proof of rights to separately distributed competition engine source, data or trained weights.
rightsAndAccess.competitionData: The official Data tab labels its license Subject to Competition Rules and blocks the card CSV/source download until sign-in/rule acceptance. Rules 2.4 limit supplied data/source to competition purpose and period, require deletion after conclusion, and limit redistribution; 3.18(f) also states restrictions on outside use of competition-trained models.
rightsAndAccess.outsideCompetition: Outside-competition engine/data/weight reuse is not cleared by the inspected evidence. Competition ending does not supply an affirmative outside-use grant. Generic algorithmic learning and appropriately licensed code reuse remain separate.
rightsAndAccess.actionTaken: Viewed official rules/data without joining, signing in, accepting rules, downloading gated data, loading foreign weights, installing CABT or executing its engine.
rightsAndAccess.state: Gated access unavailable; no action-time approval requested or pending, no auto-review denial, no uncertain external mutation.

deck.coverage: Exact 24-identity/60-card recipe verified locally. All CABT numeric ID/printing joins and rules parity remain unverified; the official registry CSV is gated. Similar Dragapult names in another author's deck do not establish this exact recipe.

verifiedPublicCode: game.battle_start checks two 60-card lists and calls the native library via ctypes without a GUI.
game.battle_select takes a list of option indices; current Python Battle state is process-global.
Public sim.py loads Windows, Linux x64/arm64 and macOS native libraries; GameInitialize/BattleStart have no exposed seed argument in the inspected binding.
cabt.json defaults to BO3/version2; legacy version1 forces BO1; episodeSteps=10000000, runTimeout=6000, remainingOverageTime=600.
documentedNotExecuted: The API documents MAIN actions and typed card, energy, attack, count, yes/no and damage-counter prompt contexts.
SearchBegin accepts hypothesized hidden deck/prize/hand allocations, manual_coin optionally controls coins; SearchStep returns a search state ID; SearchEnd/Release free search resources.
unverified: Native engine rule correctness for the pinned deck.
Exact repeatable seeding, RNG/clock behavior and replay parity.
Nondestructive branch semantics, clone cost, limits, native thread safety and search correctness.
Same-process parallel independent games; process isolation is the practical inference from wrapper singleton state, not a measured scaling result.

verified: The complete repository tree contains one Python implementation and four weight files; it does not contain the advertised PPO trainer/rewarder/rollout pipeline.
Script lines335-412 encode/evaluate a leaf, form exponentiated action-score priors and create search children.
Lines358-370 construct exactly64 candidate lists from maxCount, omit optional lower cardinalities and stop carrying when the last index is exhausted; repeated candidates are possible.
Lines426-435 independently sample hidden zones without subtracting visible cards or conserving multiplicity across zones.
Lines437-480 run25 PUCT-like expansions with explicit root perspective and choose maximum-visit action; root Dirichlet noise is mixed into raw scores before exponentiation.
The script returns no training sample and records visualization actions, not search policy targets/behavior log probabilities/optimizer updates.
Its demo reuses one agent/deck across both acting seats and ten games; it is not independent strength or ablation evidence.
unavailable: No reproducible strength result or controlled ablation was executed.
The claimed AlphaZero-plus-PPO training combination cannot be verified from checked-in code.
No behavior-ratio or on-policy correctness claim can be made for missing PPO code.

benchmark.reason: Exact deck registry/source access and outside-competition engine permission were unavailable; no engine installation/execution was performed. No matched deck, policy/action burden, completion semantics, hardware or concurrency benchmark exists.
benchmark.existingNativeNumbers: Provided historical native games/hour and fixed-replay copy diagnostics are separate evidence, not CABT comparisons.

concreteMigrationWork: Resolve engine/data permissions and reproducible package version.
Join all24 exact printings/mechanical identities to CABT IDs and verify each effect/prompt.
Replace cg.api card/attack embeddings and action IDs with native semantic identities, or adapt every native observation/prompt.
Qualify hidden-information projection, seed/replay, branching and process lifecycle.
Run a predeclared matched whole-game timing panel and an adequate strength comparison before changing engine.
adaptation.supportedTransfer: Native AlphaZero implementation retains existing actor/critic tensors and simulator; adds complete bounded legal sets, shared information-set PUCT, search-visit policy targets, tanh outcome values, natural-outcome supervised updates and explicit fallbacks. It imports no foreign weights and makes no CABT strength or Nash/exploitability claim.
adaptation.remainingQualification: Native hypothetical-state reconstruction, multiset/history consistency, actual search coverage and game latency require end-to-end qualification by the engine/execution owners.
